title: eng-hiring-onboarding-interview-debriefs-2026-05-12
content:
Meeting header: Eng Hiring & Onboarding Weekly Sync — 2026-05-12
Attendees: Maya Chen (Owner), Alex Rivera, Jordan Lee, Samir Desai, Priya Kapoor
Absentees: none

Purpose: Weekly debrief on interviews, candidate pipeline, onboarding progress for recent hires, and team health signals.

1) Interview debriefs (this week)
- Candidate A: Senior Backend Engineer (ref: JIRA-849)
  - Interviewers: Alex (system design), Jordan (runtime), Priya (culture fit)
  - Summary: Strong distributed systems background (3 years building sharded key-value systems), good on performance trade-offs, solid debugging approach. Struggled on language/runtime-specific kernel optimizations questions (low-level CUDA/TPU knowledge), but has eager learning curve.
  - Strengths: architecture, API design, monitoring/observability instincts, clear communication.
  - Concerns: limited experience on ML model serving optimizations (KV cache, attention runtimes). Ramp risk estimated moderate.
  - Panel recommendation: Hire with expectation to pair with serving-runtime engineer for first 3 months. Offer level: Senior (IC4). Next steps: Recruiter to check references; if clean, extend offer by 2026-05-14.

- Candidate B: ML Infra Engineer - Quantization & Runtime
  - Interviewers: Samir (inference), Maya (culture), Jordan (perf)
  - Summary: Deep knowledge of quantization pipelines and quant-aware training. Showed sample notebook demonstrating 8-bit quant results and had a repo with reproducible experiments.
  - Strengths: hands-on tooling, benchmark-driven approach, familiar with ONNX and quant libs.
  - Concerns: less experience with production deployment orchestration (K8s operators), but motivated; recommended to pair with Platform for first sprint.
  - Panel recommendation: Strong hire. Proposed level: Senior/Staff (IC5). Hiring manager to confirm comp band and draft offer.

- Candidate C: Staff SRE (internal referral)
  - Interviewers: Jordan (SRE), Alex (oncall), Priya (culture)
  - Summary: Excellent incident leadership experience, improved SLOs at previous company. Good on runbook design and oncall rotations.
  - Strengths: leadership, SRE tooling, incident postmortem clarity.
  - Concerns: prefers 4-day workweeks (discuss compensation/flexibility). Panel recommends proceed but clarify schedule expectations.
  - Panel recommendation: Proceed to manager final round; hiring manager to discuss schedule details.

2) Hiring pipeline and metrics
- Open reqs: 12 (Backend 4, ML Infra 3, SRE 2, Frontend 2, PM 1)
- This week: 18 interviews conducted, 5 onsite/loop equivalents (virtual), 3 offers extended last week (2 accepted, 1 pending)
- Time-to-offer median: 21 days; target: 18 days. Action: Recruiter to prioritize top-of-funnel sourcing for Backend to reduce cycle time.
- Referral update: 7 active referrals; 2 in final round.

3) Onboarding updates (recent hires)
- New hires started since last sync:
  - Lena Park (Backend) — start: 2026-05-04
    - Buddy: Jordan Lee
    - Ramp plan: Week1: env setup + code walkthrough; Week2: small bug fix; Month1: own minor feature
    - Blockers: KMS access pending (IAM ticket created, ETA 2026-05-13)
  - Marco Alvarez (Infra) — start: 2026-05-06
    - Buddy: Samir Desai
    - Ramp plan: perf lab setup, run baseline quant tests
    - Blockers: internal dataset access (security review in progress)
- Onboarding checklist status: avg completion 65% across new hires; propose a short onboarding retro to tighten first-week tasks.

4) Team health signals
- Sentiment: mixed — velocity is healthy, but increased meetings for interview loops are causing context switching pain.
- Recent incidents: one 3-hour latency regression last week; postmortem assigned to Platform team, remediation plan in JIRA-870.
- Capacity: avg sprint capacity reduced by ~8% due to hiring interviews and ramping new hires.
- Risk: burnout risk for ICs heavily involved in interviewing. Action: cap interview load to 3 loops/week per IC where possible and rotate interviewers.

5) Action items / Owners
- Recruiter (Priya) — prioritize Backend sourcing; target 3 new strong candidates by 2026-05-19. (Priya Kapoor)
- Hiring Manager (Alex) — finalize comp bands for ML Infra candidate and send offer draft by 2026-05-14. (Alex Rivera)
- Onboarding Lead (Jordan) — follow up on KMS and dataset access tickets; update onboarding checklist templates by 2026-05-16. (Jordan Lee)
- Platform (Samir) — remediate latency regression root cause and provide timeline in JIRA-870 by 2026-05-15. (Samir Desai)
- People Ops — schedule onboarding retro for hires in May (Proposed 2026-05-20).

6) Parking lot / discussion items
- Consider brief 'interview hygiene' training for engineers to reduce loop time and clarify evaluation rubrics.
- Proposal: create a 2-week 'serving-runtime bootcamp' for new hires to accelerate competency in our inference kernels and caching strategies.

Notes & links: See linked artifacts for open tickets and confluence onboarding draft. Recruiters to sync with hiring managers before next weekly meeting.

Next sync: 2026-05-19, same time.

End of notes.
